cards.ex: He knew he'd made a mistake and had to face the music.
cards.exUz: U xato qilganini va javobgarlikka tortilishi kerakligini bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan xatosi uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq, oqibatlarini ko'tarmoq.

cards.ex: The judge threw the book at him for his repeated offenses.
cards.exUz: Sudya uni qayta-qayta qonunni buzgani uchun qattiq jazoladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qattiq jazolamoq, eng og'ir jazoni qo'llamoq.

cards.ex: He broke the law, but somehow he got off scot-free.
cards.exUz: U qonunni buzdi, lekin qandaydir yo'l bilan jazolanmasdan qutuldi.
cards.uzDef: Qilmishi uchun hech qanday jazo olmasdan qutilib ketmoq.

cards.ex: The jury found him guilty beyond a reasonable doubt.
cards.exUz: Hakamlar hay'ati uni shubhasiz aybdor deb topdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday shubha qoldirmasdan, to'liq isbotlangan.

cards.ex: He decided to plead guilty to avoid a lengthy trial.
cards.exUz: U uzoq sud jarayonidan qochish uchun aybini tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda o'z aybini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: She pleaded not guilty and insisted on a trial.
cards.exUz: U aybsizligini aytdi va sudni talab qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda o'z aybsizligini e'lon qilmoq.

cards.ex: He's serving time for armed robbery.
cards.exUz: U qurolli bosqinchilik uchun qamoqda o'tiribdi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda jazo muddatini o'tamoq.

cards.ex: She's always been a law-abiding citizen.
cards.exUz: U har doim qonunga itoatkor fuqaro bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlarga rioya qiladigan, qonunni hurmat qiladigan fuqaro.

cards.ex: Eventually, the long arm of the law caught up with him.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, qonunning uzun qo'li unga yetdi.
cards.term: the long arm of the law
cards.uzDef: Qonunning uzoqqa yetishi, adolatning amalga oshishi.

cards.ex: You can't take the law into your own hands; you have to call the police.
cards.exUz: Siz o'zboshimchalik qila olmaysiz; siz politsiyaga qo'ng'iroq qilishingiz kerak.
cards.term: take the law into one's own hands
cards.uzDef: Qonunni chetlab o'tib, o'zi adolatni o'rnatmoqchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The evidence was overwhelming; it was an open-and-shut case.
cards.exUz: Dalillar juda ko'p edi; bu aniq ish edi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday bahsga o'rin qoldirmaydigan, juda aniq ish.

cards.ex: The case will be decided in a court of law.
cards.exUz: Bu ish sud tomonidan hal qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy masalalarni hal qiladigan sud joyi.

cards.ex: They exploited a legal loophole to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliq to'lamaslik uchun qonundagi teshikdan foydalanishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qonunda foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan kamchilik yoki noaniqlik.

cards.ex: The police are determined to bring the criminals to justice.
cards.exUz: Politsiya jinoyatchilarni javobgarlikka tortishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyatchini sudga olib kelib, javobgarlikka tortmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone is entitled to due process under the law.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson qonun bo'yicha tegishli tartibga ega.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy tartib-qoidalarga rioya qilish, adolatli sud jarayoni.

cards.ex: The burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
cards.exUz: Isbotlash majburiyati prokuratura zimmasida.
cards.uzDef: Da'vo qiluvchining o'z da'vosini isbotlash majburiyati.

cards.ex: The judge ruled the testimony inadmissible as hearsay evidence.
cards.exUz: Sudya guvohlikni eshitgan gap sifatida qabul qilib bo'lmasligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi qo'ldan emas, boshqalardan eshitilgan ma'lumotga asoslangan dalil.

cards.ex: The lawyer will cross-examine the witness tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Advokat ertaga guvohni so'roq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Guvohni savollar berish orqali tekshirmoq, faktlarni aniqlashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The trial ended in a hung jury.
cards.exUz: Sud kelishuvsiz hakamlar bilan yakunlandi.
cards.uzDef: Bir qarorga kela olmagan hakamlar hay'ati.

cards.ex: The offer was made without prejudice.
cards.exUz: Taklif zararsiz qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa huquqlarga zarar yetkazmasdan, o'zgartirishsiz.

cards.ex: The company is liable for the damage caused by its products.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'z mahsulotlari keltirgan zarar uchun javobgar.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy ravishda javobgar bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: She decided to sue the company for discrimination.
cards.exUz: U kamsitish uchun kompaniyani sudga berishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir sudga berib, qonuniy talablar qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: They decided to settle out of court to avoid legal fees.
cards.exUz: Ular sud xarajatlaridan qochish uchun sudsiz kelishishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Sudga yetmasdan, tomonlar o'zaro kelishib olishi.

cards.ex: He's on probation for two years.
cards.exUz: U ikki yil sinov muddatida.
cards.uzDef: Jinoiy jazoning bir turi, ozodlikda, nazorat ostida.

cards.ex: She was sentenced to community service.
cards.exUz: U jamoat ishlariga hukm qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Jazo sifatida jamoat foydasi uchun bajariladigan ish.

cards.ex: He's been behind bars for ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yildan beri panjara ortida.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda, hibsda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Having a criminal record can make it hard to get a job.
cards.exUz: Sudlanganlik tarixi ish topishni qiyinlashtirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jinoyat sodir etgan shaxsning qonuniy ro'yxati.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves their day in court.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson sudda o'z fikrini himoya qilishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: O'z nuqtai nazarini himoya qilish uchun sudga borish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The statute of limitations has expired on that crime.
cards.exUz: Bu jinoyat bo'yicha da'vo muddati tugagan.
cards.uzDef: Da'vo qo'zg'atish uchun belgilangan vaqt chegarasi.

cards.ex: He followed the letter of the law, but not the spirit.
cards.exUz: U qonun matniga rioya qildi, lekin ruhiga emas.
cards.uzDef: Qonunning aniq ma'nosi, qoidasi, ruhiga emas, so'zma-so'z.
